description: Thousands of sailors and Marines aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln returned home after a record-long deployment. They got a chance to hug their loved ones, and some new dads got a chance to hold their babies for the first time. NBC News’ Courtney Kube was there.
title: USS Abraham Lincoln sailors reunite with loved ones after nearly a year away

description: Political donations of billionaire Les Wexner and other Epstein associates are coming into focus in Ohio's Senate race. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports on an exhibit of the Epstein Files making a stop in Columbus, Ohio and takes a closer look at how millions of dollars are being spent, mostly by Democrats, to shape the midterms.
title: Survivors work to keep Epstein files in spotlight ahead of midterm elections in Ohio

description: Police charged demonstrators with clubs and fired tear gas as protesters resisted a crackdown, vowing to keep fighting for what they say are France’s broken schools. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports.
title: Clashes erupt between French police and protesters demanding better schools

author: Tim Stelloh
description: A series of deaths along a short stretch of a river trail in Michigan’s capital city may be the result of a serial killer, authorities said.
title: Lansing police chief warns there may be a serial killer in Michigan’s capital city

description: Families are racing to prepare with some ordered to evacuate as Hurricane Isaias closes in. Isaias rapidly intensified and accelerated as it roared toward the coast. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch is in the storm zone.
title: Hurricane Isaias set to slam Gulf Coast

description: The Pentagon said it will livestream the execution of the Fort Hood shooter who killed 13 people in 2009. President Trump has ordered the execution will be by firing squad. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.

title: NASA SpaceX Crew-12 return to Earth after undocking from the ISS

description: After a record-setting and difficult deployment to the Middle East, the USS Abraham Lincoln, carrying some 5,000 service members, will finally arrive home. The aircraft carrier that was plagued by supply shortages and low morale during its nearly year-long assignment, is scheduled to dock in San Diego on Thursday, setting the scene for emotional family reunions. NBC’s Courtney Kube reports for TODAY from aboard the Lincoln.
title: USS Lincoln Set to Port in San Diego After Record Deployment

description: Gillio Lopes, one of the seven fraternity members accused of sexually assaulting a student back in 2024, is taking legal action, calling the governor’s appointment of New York Attorney General Letitia James “improper,” saying she’s already formed an opinion about the case in comments in social media. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.
title: Accused Cornell Frat Member Seeks to Have AG James Removed

description: Officials are issuing warnings from Louisiana to Florida and preparations are underway after Tropical Storm Isaias strengthened into a hurricane and targets the Gulf Coast. Nearly a foot of rain, a dangerous storm surge and potential tornadoes are possible throughout the weekend. TODAY’s Al Roker tracks the forecast.
title: Tropical Storm Isaias Strengthens Into Category 1 Hurricane
